task.title: Create a necessary cookie only for active contact
task.input: Shared HTTP/config and ChatSessionDTO; section 09/10 necessary-session/same-origin/expiry rules.
task.output: ChatVisitorSession; POST /api/chat/session and cookie validation/bounded touch.
task.accept: 1) Caller/wiring point: real POST /api/chat/session -> visitor-session. Only active contact creates a random 256-bit token/hashed database record with Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite=Lax/Path=/api/chat and no Domain/PII. Missing/declined analytics does not block it; ordinary web GETs issue no chat cookie (E-40). 2) Enforce seven idle days/30 absolute days from first issuance; equality/revocation rejects. Check validity before touch. Reuse a valid cookie. Without one, unknown outcomes do not loop automatic creation; the same email cannot restore an old session. Apply exact Origin and limits of 10/10min per cookie and 20/10min per IP-HMAC (E-85).
